notes.title: Version 2.00 Steam
notes.notes:
[h2]Version 2.00 Now Available for Steam Version of "明日、初めて彼女と❤"![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714232/ed9a2ada670ff0827175c83e143b91f83866a46a.png[/img]

Here are the added features:
[list]
[*] Added the feature for the "写真の中の彼女" parts to appear after the TRUE END, along with expanded scenarios and the addition of one new ending
[*] Added 4 types of body parts, with expanded scenarios
[*] Added a screen size of 1200×900 and improved the smoothness of rendering when changing screen size
※ Please note that this feature is not available if your monitor size is smaller than the screen size.
[/list]

Here are the fixes and changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the color tone of the name box in the backlog turns pink when returning to the screen
[*] Fixed the issue where the angle of the 2-shot photo differs between the game screen and saved images
[*] Fixed inconsistencies between choice description text and background images
[*] Fixed the issue where names are not displayed in some dialogues
[*] Changed the achievement conditions for the Steam version of "彼女マニア" and "明日、初めて彼女と❤" to match the added features
※ This change won't impact achievements you've already earned.
[*] Fixed the issue where images could not be saved with "ツーショット写真を保存"
[/list]

Please enjoy your first date with your [b]unique[/b] girlfriend! 💕

notes.title: Steam Edition 1st Anniversary & Version 2.00 Update Teaser!
notes.notes:
[h2]Celebrating the 1st Anniversary of "明日、初めて彼女と❤" on Steam - August 11, 2023(Japan Time)![/h2]
[previewyoutube=iQ2AFDu1pzw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Anniversary Lineup ①[/h3]
Version 2.00 Update scheduled for August 11, 2023 (Japan Time)!

The upcoming update includes the following:
[list]
[*] Parts from "Girl in the Picture" will be available after achieving the TRUE END.
[*] Four new body type parts with mini-events added.
[*] Added screen size 1200×900.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Also, with this update, the conditions to earn the achievements "彼女マニア" and "明日、初めて彼女と❤" will be modified.
※ There will be no impact on previously earned achievements.

[h3]Anniversary Lineup ②[/h3]
The spin-off manga "アヤの前日譚" will be freely available on the official website and Twitter starting August 9, 2023 (Japan Time)!
Updates will be posted every week, four pages at a time. Stay tuned!

[url=https://shinkigames.blogspot.com/p/tomorrow.html]Official Page of "明日、初めて彼女と❤"[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/CreationShinki]しんき創作 on Twitter[/url]

Thank you for your continued support of "明日、初めて彼女と❤"! We hope you'll keep enjoying it in the days to come!
